newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Tuesday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Tuesday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Tuesday:

Spokesman Jochen Kubosch said the judgments made by the Court of Justice were on conditions of repayment of customs levies in the French overseas departments, aid to investment granted by the Spanish government to Piezas y Rodajes SA and on a 1992 Council regulation banning trade between the EU and the republics of Serbia and Montenegro.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/11: Commission authorizes the acquisition by Rheinbraun Brennstoff GmbH and SHV Energy NV of joint control of the hard coal trading activities of Stinnes AG.
- Memo/97/5: Euro-Mediterranean partnership: implementation of the multilateral aspects of the Barcelona declaration.
- Business and consumer surveys No 12 - December 1996: Modest investment growth expected.
- Eurostat news release No 2/97: EU GDP up by 0.76%.
- Committee of the Regions press release: The Committee of the Regions welcomes Portuguese Republic President Jorge Sampaio and Commissioners Marcelino Oreja, Mario Monti and Franz Fischler.
